svg.title: Four ACI principles form a loop: a simple action, concise feedback, and validation that returns evidence instead of letting a bad result propagate.
svg.desc: Action nodes cover simple, compact tool design. Feedback covers concise, high-signal results. Validation, the focus node, rejects malformed input and output before they can become the next action, and a conditional edge returns that evidence to the Action node instead of letting the loop continue on bad state.

svg.text: Design the interface, not just the schema
